Set the Safe Mode Using the API

When using Asciidoctor via the API, the default safe mode is SECURE. You can change the safe mode using the :safe API option.

Set :safe option

The safe mode can be controlled from the API using the :safe option. The :safe option is accepted by all entrypoint methods (e.g., Asciidoctor#convert_file).

The :safe option accepts the safe mode as a string:

Asciidoctor.convert_file 'doc.adoc', safe: 'server'

as a symbol (preferred):

Asciidoctor.convert_file 'doc.adoc', safe: :server

as an integer:

Asciidoctor.convert_file 'doc.adoc', safe: 10

You can also set the safe mode from the CLI and enable or disable content based on the current safe mode.
